items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Terry, the ultimate businessman, he put all these things together... So we did that. I wrote a bunch of charts... I had a lot of fun on those gigs.

ctx.x: Yes. This date was in ‟58, November ‟58.

This date, I don‟t know anything about. I don‟t remember Pete writing for Terry. I think it was only the sax section – sax section and rhythm. I remember he did some dates with that combination, but I don‟t recall that particular one.
Then closing out the year of ‟58 with what I hopefully have identified correctly as a significant date, and that‟s Ella Swings Lightly, Ella Fitzgerald accompanied by Marty Paich‟s Dek-tette.
